page_summary: This page discusses common entry points for cyber incidents in port ecosystems, highlighting vulnerabilities such as phishing, software exploitation, and third-party compromises. It emphasizes the importance of addressing known weaknesses to prevent cyber threats.

regions.label: Table 3
regions.description: Table summarizing common entry points for cyber incidents in the port ecosystem, including entry points like Phishing & Spear-Phishing, Exploitation of Known Software Vulnerabilities, IT/OT Convergence & Ransomware Propagation, Third-Party & Supply Chain Compromise, Port Community Systems & Web Application Vulnerabilities, GPS Spoofing & AIS Manipulation, and Legacy & Outdated Systems.
